---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a user-facing improvement or architecture change
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## User Problem

Who needs this and what are they unable to do today?

## Proposed Outcome

Describe the observable result, not only an implementation or dependency name.

## Alternatives

What simpler workflow, existing command, official Figma capability, competing OSS, or fork change was considered?

## Compatibility

Could this alter CLI commands, JSON output, MCP tool schemas, exported APIs, generated code, token formats or configuration precedence?

## Security And Privacy

Does it add or change:

- token handling
- network listeners or remote access
- persistent storage
- private Figma content
- shell, file or browser access
- write capability
- telemetry
- fork permissions or secrets

## Plan And API Assumptions

Link current primary Figma or MCP documentation for behavior that may change. Avoid relying only on screenshots or old third-party posts.

## Testing

Describe unit, fixture, smoke, integration and real-device testing needed.

## Fork Or Prior Work

Link any fork commit, repository, issue, paper or implementation that should receive attribution.

## Scope Boundary

What should deliberately remain out of this feature?
